description: gnomAD v4 RAC2 pLoF allele spectrum, carrier frequency and Hardy-Weinberg projection of IMD73C birth prevalence under random mating and consanguinity
code:
import requests, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0","Content-Type":"application/json"})

q="""{ gene(gene_symbol:"RAC2", reference_genome: GRCh38){
  gnomad_constraint{ exp_lof obs_lof oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper pLI mis_z lof_z }
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id hgvsp consequence flags
    genome{ ac an homozygote_count } exome{ ac an homozygote_count } } } }"""
r=S.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q}, timeout=120)
g=r.json()["data"]["gene"]; C=g["gnomad_constraint"]
print("gnomAD v4 constraint:", {k:(round(v,4) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in C.items()})

LOF={"stop_gained","frameshift_variant","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant"}
rows=[]
for v in g["variants"]:
    if v["consequence"] in LOF:
        ac=(v["exome"]["ac"] if v["exome"] else 0)+(v["genome"]["ac"] if v["genome"] else 0)
        an=max((v["exome"]["an"] if v["exome"] else 0),(v["genome"]["an"] if v["genome"] else 0))
        hom=(v["exome"]["homozygote_count"] if v["exome"] else 0)+(v["genome"]["homozygote_count"] if v["genome"] else 0)
        if ac>0: rows.append({"variant":v["variant_id"],"hgvsp":v["hgvsp"],"csq":v["consequence"],"ac":ac,"an":an,"hom":hom,"af":ac/an})
L=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("af",ascending=False)
print(f"\npLoF variants observed in gnomAD v4: {len(L)}; total minor alleles {L.ac.sum()}; homozygotes {L.hom.sum()}")
print(L.head(12).round(8).to_string(index=False))
qLoF=L.ac.sum()/L.an.max()
print(f"\ncumulative pLoF allele frequency q = {qLoF:.3e}  (carrier frequency 2q = 1 in {1/(2*qLoF):,.0f})")

# Hardy-Weinberg birth prevalence, random mating and with inbreeding coefficient F
for F,lab in [(0,"random mating"),(0.0625,"first-cousin union, F=1/16"),(0.03125,"second-cousin, F=1/32")]:
    p_hom=qLoF**2*(1-F)+qLoF*F
    print(f"  {lab:34s} expected biallelic pLoF birth prevalence = {p_hom:.3e}  (1 in {1/p_hom:,.0f})")
p_rand=qLoF**2
print(f"\nRandom-mating projection corresponds to {p_rand*1e5:.2e} cases per 100,000 births, i.e. roughly {p_rand*1.3e8:.2f} affected births per year worldwide at 130 million annual births.")
print("Note: gnomAD homozygote count for pLoF RAC2 alleles is", int(L.hom.sum()), "so no biallelic LoF individual is present in 807,162 gnomAD v4 exomes/genomes.")

# orthologues for sections 14-15
mg=S.get("https://mygene.info/v3/query", params={"q":"symbol:RAC2","species":"human,mouse,rat,zebrafish,fruitfly,nematode","fields":"symbol,taxid,entrezgene,name","size":20}, timeout=60).json()
print("\nRAC2 orthologue-name search:")
for h in mg.get("hits",[]): print(" ", h.get("taxid"), h.get("symbol"), h.get("entrezgene"), h.get("name"))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14.6,5.6))
ax=axes[0]
labels=["observed pLoF\nalleles","expected pLoF\nalleles"]
ax.bar(labels,[C["obs_lof"],C["exp_lof"]], color=["#C03221","#9aa5b1"], width=0.55)
for i,v in enumerate([C["obs_lof"],C["exp_lof"]]): ax.text(i,v+0.4,f"{v:.1f}", ha="center", fontsize=10, weight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("allele count in gnomAD v4", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_title(f"A  RAC2 tolerates almost no loss of function\no/e = {C['oe_lof']:.3f} (90% CI {C['oe_lof_lower']:.2f}-{C['oe_lof_upper']:.2f}), pLI = {C['pLI']:.3f}, LOEUF = {C['oe_lof_upper']:.2f}",
             fontsize=10, loc="left", weight="bold")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
F=np.linspace(0,0.0625,200)
prev=qLoF**2*(1-F)+qLoF*F
ax.plot(F, prev, color="#C03221", lw=2.2)
for f,lab in [(0,"random\nmating"),(0.03125,"second\ncousins"),(0.0625,"first\ncousins")]:
    v=qLoF**2*(1-f)+qLoF*f
    ax.scatter([f],[v], s=55, color="#C03221", zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(f"{lab}\n1 in {1/v:,.0f}", (f,v), xytext=(6,-6 if f==0 else 4), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8.2)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("inbreeding coefficient F", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_ylabel("expected birth prevalence of biallelic RAC2 pLoF", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_title(f"B  Consanguinity raises expected IMD73C birth prevalence by {((qLoF**2*(1-0.0625)+qLoF*0.0625)/qLoF**2):,.0f}-fold\ncumulative pLoF allele frequency q = {qLoF:.1e}, carrier frequency 1 in {1/(2*qLoF):,.0f}",
             fontsize=10, loc="left", weight="bold")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
